source: user local machine, batch-20261014-222237 (P2 seeds 2026/3140 x2) and batch-20261014-222300 (P2 seed 8675 x3), started 24 s apart on the same bridge port; commit 05ed1a5
notes: The two batches ran concurrently on port 8766 and shared one bridge (Windows lets a second server bind the same port), so P2/2026 r1 and P2/8675 r1 stopped on the bridge call budget (78 + 74 calls) and P2/8675 r2/r3 failed at their first call. Infrastructure/procedure, not control; fixed afterwards (runner refuses a busy port; bridges no longer reuse addresses on Windows).

P2/3140 r1 and r2 both failed in trial 3 at the 180-action cap; offline replay reproduces it (60/53/180 and 55/44/180). Cause: during transport the elbow joint sits at its limit, every recent sample is limited and both controllers drop limited samples, so the local model cannot be refit; r1 falls back to probes[h.length % 4], which is constant once history is saturated at 40, and r2 keeps commanding the limited joint while only the base moves. The arm circles the base instead of backing the elbow off. The C-version P2/3140 controllers, the reference module and the offline baseline complete this trial. No isolation case holds a joint at its limit with saturated history, so the gate did not catch it.
Completed controllers (offline replay over five trials): P2/2026 r1 320 (1.14x), r2 271 (0.96x); P2/8675 r1 265 (0.94x).
